entities.name: Kaapo Kähkönen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kaapo Kähkönen is a Finnish professional ice hockey goaltender for the Laval Rocket of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Montreal Canadiens of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the fourth round, 109th overall, by the Minnesota Wild in the 2014 NHL entry draft. Kähkönen has also previously played for the San Jose Sharks, New Jersey Devils, and Colorado Avalanche.
